catatan: Uji mode gambar dulu (owner 05:26): gambar awal klip 1 dan 3 dibuat dan dicek dulu, video setelah lolos. Tanpa adegan berbalik ke kamera.
lokasi: A small Indonesian family house before dawn.
latar: quiet house before dawn, faint crickets outside

klip.pakaian: a loose light-grey long-sleeved cotton pajama shirt and matching light-grey pajama trousers, barefoot
klip.lokasi: A small, tidy Indonesian teenage boy's bedroom before dawn: a single bed with a rumpled blue blanket, a wooden desk with a small warm lamp, a closed wooden door on the right, dark blue sky outside the window.

kamera.posisi: behind Uwais at chest height, a little to his left, medium full shot
kamera.fokus: Uwais sitting on the edge of his bed

klip.awal: Uwais sits cross-legged on his bed on the blue blanket, seen from behind, the warm desk lamp glowing.

aksi.aksi: He stretches both arms up slowly and lowers them.
He moves to the edge of the bed, puts his bare feet on the floor, and stands up.

klip.akhir: Uwais stands next to the bed, full body, seen from behind.

foley.suara: a distant adzan subuh from the mosque

kamera.gerak: following him slowly at the same speed

klip.awal: Uwais stands next to the bed.

aksi.aksi: He walks at normal speed to the closed bedroom door.
He opens the door with his right hand and steps into the doorway.
aksi.kamera: the camera stays a few steps behind him, his whole body in view

klip.akhir: Uwais stands in the open doorway, full body, seen from behind.

klip.pakaian: a clean white long-sleeved koko shirt with a standing collar, a dark green checkered sarong reaching the ankles, a plain white knitted peci on his head, barefoot
klip.lokasi: A calm Indonesian family living room before dawn: a green prayer mat on the floor facing a plain wall, a low wooden cabinet, a window with thin curtains, soft warm lamp light.

kamera.posisi: behind Uwais at waist height, medium full shot
kamera.fokus: Uwais standing on the prayer mat

klip.awal: Uwais stands upright on the green prayer mat, seen from behind, facing the wall.
klip.aksi: He raises both open hands up beside his ears, then lowers them and folds his right hand over his left on his chest.
klip.akhir: Uwais stands still on the prayer mat with his hands folded on his chest, full body, seen from behind.

kamera.gerak: moving slowly down to his level, keeping his whole upper body in view

klip.awal: Uwais stands on the prayer mat.

aksi.aksi: He sits down on the prayer mat with his legs folded under him.
He raises both open palms in front of his chest to pray.
aksi.ucapan: Ya Allah, terima kasih untuk pagi ini.

klip.akhir: Uwais sits on the prayer mat with his palms raised, upper body in view, seen from behind.

cek_gambar.SHOT03-2: LOLOS: koko putih, sarung hijau kotak, peci, kaki telanjang, wajah tidak terlihat
